messages:
taylor: Dropping a new iteration of the latency distribution tile. Uses a half-violin on the left + a sparkline on the right, with a rug plot for raw outliers. Mock: https://redwood.design/threads/half-violin-rug maria: Love the mixed visualization idea. two product asks: make unit switching clearer (ms vs s) and ensure the tooltip calls out whether the violin is clipped or not jon: Agree on tooltip. Also the smoothing is currently aggressive 10 which flattens short-lived p99 spikes. Can we expose a simple combobox: none / light / medium / heavy? Prefer "light" as default kim: A11y: contrast between rug dots and half-violin is borderline. Use color palette v3 (colorblind-safe) and add a visible focus ring for keyboard nav. Screen reader summary needs to be actionable, not just "chart" taylor: Implementation plan: add unit toggle inside legend labeled "Units (axis & tooltips)", smoothing combobox with presets, and a small badge on the axis when clipping is active. For outliers: clip violin to 99.7th percentile, render beyond points as larger rug markers with tooltip showing original value maria: If we clip, text on the axis should be explicit: e.g., "Request latency — ms (values clipped to 99.7th pct)". Also add a little info icon that opens a microcopy overlay explaining density vs count jon: Behavior detail: hovering a rug outlier should show the raw timestamp + full value and a link to the traces view. Otherwise SREs will be annoyed design-bot: Added tasks to ticket D-998: color palette update, focus styles, unit toggle copy change, smoothing combobox, clipping badge and info overlay kim: Copy suggestion for the legend helper: "Show axis units used for graph and tooltips". For SR aria-label: "Latency distribution for route /v1/complete. median 38 ms, p95 122 ms. 3 values above 1s shown as outliers." taylor: Quick example SR/html we can drop in docs:\n```html\n
\n \n
\n``` maria: I'll add Storybook stories for each smoothing preset + a11y snapshot tests checking the aria-labels and focus order jon: :thumbsup: small request - when unit = seconds, update tick formatting to 2 decimal places for subsecond values, otherwise engineers will misread 0.123 as 123ms
